description: This file defines the DUEL templating engine, including type definitions, binding logic, rendering functions, and DOM manipulation methods. It provides functions for template compilation, data binding, and rendering to HTML or DOM elements, with support for custom callbacks and error handling.

classes.name: Markup
classes.description: Wraps a string value to maintain as raw markup in output, with a toString method for rendering.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents a template rendering result, with methods to convert to string, DOM, or reload the document.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: String buffer for efficient HTML string concatenation, with append and toString methods.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type of a value, returning a numeric code.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if a value is an array.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if a value is a function.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a child node or attribute to a parent node in the template structure.

methods.name: bindContent
methods.description: Binds a template node to data, producing a fragment or value.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Handles iteration over arrays or objects for template binding.

methods.name: part
methods.description: Replaces a placeholder part with a named partial view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Main function to bind a template node to data, dispatching based on node type.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Wraps a view definition with a binding method, returning a Result object.

methods.name: duel
methods.description: Main exported function to create a bound view or retrieve an existing one.

methods.name: toDOM
methods.description: Converts a template result to DOM nodes, optionally replacing an existing element.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Replaces the entire document with the current template result.
